notes: Run for anthropic-skills:pokemon-card-price-check, 2026-09-23 (Wednesday) — psa_tier_status check skipped (weekly, Monday-only). All 11 tracked cards' SNKRDUNK data (favorite counts, PSA10/A-grade listings and completed sales) collected via live browser interaction per the skill's anti-fabrication requirement; recent_completed_sales entries were re-verified via a second live pass against each card's 売買履歴 grade-filtered pill (rather than reused from an earlier summarized/compressed date range) to guarantee exact price/date pairing. All 11 image URLs reused from the skill's cached table — no fresh image fetch needed. The six M6a '30th CELEBRATION' cards (Gengar ex SAR, Mew ex SAR, Jirachi ex SAR, Mewtwo ex SAR, and both Pikachu ex SAR day/night prints), released 2026-09-16, still have no altema.jp PSA10 population/gem-rate data — expected, PSA grading has not turned around yet. Notable pattern: three of these six (Mew ex SAR, Mewtwo ex SAR, Pikachu ex SAR day/126) show isolated completed PSA10 sales (2 each) despite zero currently-active PSA10 listings, suggesting very early, thin PSA10 supply starting to trade even before population data appears; the other three (Gengar ex SAR, Jirachi ex SAR, Pikachu ex SAR night/127) show zero PSA10 activity of any kind so far. pokeca-chart.com's 取引件数 (transaction volume) overlay toggle was attempted on the PSA10 index page; it did not render a usable trend series in page text (only a single hover-tooltip data point, 331 transactions at one date), consistent with the skill's documented unreliability for this control — volume_trend recorded as not captured for both indices rather than guessed.
